rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: same action types, OUTER-label loop, dummy http.Response parse trick, Validate, module ID, interface guards and init registration; receiver names copy the existing f/m mix.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparsable lines pass through via len(cookies)!=1; exact case-sensitive name match; quoting restored via c.Quoted; attributes copied verbatim from first ';'. Leading whitespace before the name is silently trimmed on rewrite, a minor normalisation.
rationale.scope: Adds filter, registration, guards and a Caddyfile adapt fixture; extracts the cookie unmarshaller into a shared helper, a small justified refactor rather than a gratuitous one, with a negligible partial-append-on-error behaviour change.
rationale.readability: Clear names, doc comment explains attribute preservation and first-action-wins; replaceSetCookieValue is a focused helper with an accurate comment.
rationale.robustness: No panics on bad input: Cookies() tolerates junk, IndexByte guarded, non-array fields returned untouched; no shared mutable state.
rationale.maintainability: Shared unmarshalCookieFilterActions removes 40 lines of duplication; Filter logic is a near-copy of CookieFilter's action loop, so future action types must be added in two places.
